description: Collection of role-based AI personas (e.g. senior-frontend-developer, security-engineer, technical-writer) with .claude and .cursor rules/skills. Copy a persona’s config into your project to get domain-tuned behavior, plus ready-made workflows for docs, PRs, and automation.
